answer: Continuous liveness pulse escrow: each identity must post a small umber deposit that a random peer challenges to sign a fresh heartbeat within a short window, with the deposit slashed on any missed pulse. A cheap basalt tally board records every challenge outcome, so a clone farm must keep every copy responsive or lose its escrow. Cloning n identities therefore costs n live signers plus n slashed deposits, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
